ability.ash_cloud.desc: Channels an ash cloud over an area: 8 waves of magic damage, 25 mana per wave. A new order interrupts it.
ability.ash_cloud.name: Ash Cloud
ability.blizzard.desc: Channels an ice storm over an area: 8 waves of magic damage, 25 mana per wave. A new order interrupts it.
ability.blizzard.name: Blizzard
ability.bloodlust.desc: Enrages an ally for 20 s: damage +50%, attack speed +50% and movement +25%.
ability.bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
ability.death_touch.desc: Drains the life of an enemy; the necromancer recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
ability.death_touch.name: Death Touch
ability.debug_bolt.desc: Test ability: deals magic damage to an enemy.
ability.debug_bolt.name: Test Bolt
ability.debug_heal.name: Test Heal
ability.exorcism.desc: Hurts only the undead: deals magic damage up to the target HP, 4 mana per HP.
ability.exorcism.name: Exorcism
ability.eye_of_watch.desc: Summons a flying eye (60 s): sees far and reveals invisible units. Immune to damage; controllable.
ability.eye_of_watch.name: Watching Eye
ability.fireball.desc: Hurls a fireball that pierces and burns up to 3 enemies in a line.
ability.fireball.name: Fireball
ability.flameshield.desc: Wraps an ally in flames for 30 s: melee attackers take 8 magic damage per hit.
ability.flameshield.name: Flame Shield
ability.haste_spell.desc: Speeds up an ally (movement and attack +50%) for 30 s.
ability.haste_spell.name: Haste
ability.heal.desc: Heals an ally (5 HP per second, 6 mana per HP) while it is wounded and mana remains. Auto-cast: heals allies below 60% HP.
ability.heal.name: Heal
ability.holy_vision.desc: Reveals an area (radius 10) of the map for 20 s, showing units and buildings there.
ability.holy_vision.name: Holy Sight
ability.invisibility.desc: Makes an ally invisible until it attacks, casts or takes damage. Enemies only see it up close or with detectors.
ability.invisibility.name: Invisibility
ability.polymorph.desc: Turns an enemy (except heroes, siege and buildings) into a helpless sheep, permanently.
ability.polymorph.name: Polymorph
ability.raise_dead.desc: Consumes up to 2 corpses within a radius of 6 and raises 1 skeleton per corpse (lasts 60 s).
ability.raise_dead.name: Raise Dead
ability.runes.desc: Scatters 6 runes (invisible to enemies) in a circle; each explodes when stepped on (60 area magic damage). Last 60 s; max 12 active.
ability.runes.name: Explosive Runes
ability.slow.desc: Halves the speed of an enemy for 30 s.
ability.slow.name: Slow
ability.unholy_armor.desc: Makes an ally invulnerable for 6 s; afterwards it loses 50% of its current health.
ability.unholy_armor.name: Unholy Armor
ability.whirlwind.desc: Summons a whirlwind that roams for 12 s dealing 12 magic damage per second to ground units (allies too).
ability.whirlwind.name: Whirlwind

credits.note: Inspired by the real-time strategy classics of the 90s. All names, factions and characters are original.
faction.human.desc: Solid walls, heavy horsemen and trained archers. A steady economy and a defense that is hard to break.
faction.human.name: Human Kingdom
faction.orc.desc: Sturdy warriors and mass assaults. Constant pressure from the first minutes of the match.
faction.orc.name: Orc Clans
help.build: 🏠 Construct buildings: select a worker to open the build menu (house, lumber camp, barracks, tower, farm…).
help.chop: 🪓 Chop trees: select a worker and right-click any tree to harvest wood. When full, it delivers the wood to the Hall or Lumber Camp by itself!
help.defend: 🏹 Defense and victory: bandits raid from the southern outpost! Build watchtowers to defend, or march your army to the Bandit Camp and destroy it for victory!
help.intro: Welcome, Commander! Build your low-poly realm, expand your economy, train an army and protect the realm from bandit raiders!
help.mine: ⛏️ Mine gold and stone: select a worker and right-click the Gold Mine or Stone Quarry to extract the minerals.
help.title: ⚔️ Kingdom of WarPoly ⚔️
help.train: 🛡️ Train warriors: select your Barracks to train heavy infantry and sharpshooting archers.

tut.attack.text: Select your soldiers (drag a box or click them) and right-click the camp to attack. Destroy it to claim the reward!
tut.attack.title: Attack the Bandit Camp
tut.barracks.text: With the farm ready, pick the Barracks (key B) and place it. This is where you train soldiers.
tut.barracks.title: Build barracks
tut.done.text: You have mastered the basics: gathering, building, training and attacking. Keep playing freely or return to the menu and start a Skirmish.
tut.done.title: Tutorial complete!
tut.farm.text: The Barracks requires a Farm. Select a worker, pick the Farm (key F) and place it near your base. It also grants population.
tut.farm.title: Build a farm
tut.gold.text: Select a worker and right-click the Gold Mine. Gold pays for troops and advanced buildings.
tut.gold.title: Gather gold
tut.house.text: Select a worker, pick the Cottage in the build panel (or press C) and click the ground to place it. Houses raise your population limit.
tut.house.title: Build a house
tut.select.text: Click one of your villagers (or drag a box around them). Use W A S D or the arrow keys to move the camera and the mouse wheel to zoom.
tut.select.title: Select a worker
tut.train.text: Click the Barracks and use the training buttons (keys Q, W). Each unit joins the queue and uses population.
tut.train.title: Train 2 soldiers
tut.wood.text: With the worker selected, right-click a tree. It chops, carries the wood to the Castle and returns by itself.
tut.wood.title: Gather wood
